chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Faddal from Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who visited the House (Kaaba) and did not shave his head, he said: He should shave it in Mecca and carry his hair to Mina, and there is no penalty upon him.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim forgets to shave his head during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the procedural flexibility in Hajj rituals, specifically addressing the timing and location of Halq (shaving) when a pilgrim delays it beyond the initial window. It highlights the scholarly consensus that the act remains valid without penalty (Kaffarah) provided the hair is carried to Mina, reflecting the practical ease (Yusr) emphasized in Shia fiqh. The chain of transmission through Abu Basir underscores the reliability of this ruling within the Imami tradition.
